The outline mostly traces the gold skeleton lines (head to body, body to each wingtip) and adds a stray hook, so it reads as a copy of the gold lines rather than a real silhouette.

The breast label (star 93017) and the body-centre label (star 93194) overlap each other and the right-wingtip label, and the tail label overlaps the body label near (315-330, 295-305). The labels are unreadable.

Star placement is ambiguous. Star 93017 (breast) sits almost on the body centre instead of at the neck-to-body junction, and star 93194 (the brightest, body centre) is not visually distinct from the breast. Star 92420 (right wingtip) at about (373,275) is well out from the body, which is fine, but the wing has no shape connecting it to the body.
The tail (93279, about (314,312)) hangs below the body as a small dot with a loop, not a clear tail fan.
Orientation is plausible (head is up, wings spread sideways), but the neck is a thin straight spike rather than a curved neck.
